citation: Ahmed, Raza et al. 2016, Int. J. Hydrogen Energy

materials.secondary_phase: Na2CO3 (used in synthesis; Ba reacts with SDC at 800 C to form barium cerate)
materials.notes: dopant_fraction 0.20 is the Sm:Ce ratio (1:4 = 20%). SDC:Ba(NO3)2 molar ratio 1:1. FC pellet 1 mm x 13 mm, sintered 500 C 30 min before test. No conductivity or Pmax numbers tabulated for Sample-1 in extracted text (Fig. 5 shows 300-500 C curves; Table 2 not captured).

dopant_fraction 0.20 is the Sm:Ce ratio. SDC:La(NO3)3 molar ratio 1:1. Paper notes La did not react with SDC at 800 C (unlike Ba). No conductivity or Pmax numbers tabulated in extracted text (Fig. 6 shows curves).

Best-performing sample. Conductivity pellet: 2.05 mm x 13 mm, active area 0.64 cm2, Ag paste current collectors. Also 0.015 S/cm at 600 C in air atmosphere. Pmax 350 mW/cm2 cited at both 500 C (abstract) and 550 C (conclusion); using 550 C from conclusion. FC pellet was 1 mm x 13 mm (separate from conductivity pellet). Qualitative statement 'stable conductivity with aging' but no hours reported.

materials.composition_label: BSDC-carbonate [Sample-4] (SDC + Ba(NO3)2 + citric acid chelating agent, wet chemical)
materials.secondary_phase: Na2CO3 (implicit from SDC precipitation step; no Na2CO3 added in Sample-4 step)
materials.synthesis_route: wet chemical with citric acid chelating agent
materials.notes: SDC:Ba(NO3)2 molar ratio 1:2 (0.0125 M Ba(NO3)2 vs 0.005 M Sm), with 0.0125 mol citric acid as chelator. No conductivity or Pmax numbers tabulated in extracted text (Fig. 8 shows curves).

extraction_notes: Table 2 (fuel cell performance comparison) is referenced in text but its numeric contents are not present in the extracted full-text (likely lost in PDF layout). Only Sample-3 has explicit conductivity and Pmax values in the text. dopant_fraction is set to the Sm:Ce ratio (0.20); the Ba/La additions are 1:1 molar with the doped ceria and form separate phases (BaCeO3 for Ba, unreacted La2O3 for La) per Raman/XRD discussion, so they are not treated as substitutional dopants on the Ce site. Secondary_phase_wt_pct not stated. Relative density, activation energy, OCV values, and durability hours not reported.
